note: The exact manifest that produced the committed results/local-demo-* rows.
It costs nothing: one local run plus two containers off free public images.
It proves the RUNNER (ship -> execute -> collect -> fold) and produces real
per-axis differences for glibc / libstdcxx / os_release / cxx_compiler. It
does NOT prove portability: the containers have no torch, so their rows are
INCONCLUSIVE by construction and are excluded from the contingency. Real
compatibility verdicts need the pod targets in targets.example.json.
`python` for the local target points at a venv that actually has torch and
the package installed; the generic example manifest says python3.

targets.name: local-demo-build-host
targets.axis_intent: the build host itself — all axes equal, the control row

targets.name: local-demo-debian12
targets.axis_intent: glibc/libstdcxx/os_release/cxx_compiler one LTS step below the build host

targets.name: local-demo-debian11
targets.axis_intent: glibc/libstdcxx two LTS steps below — the oldest base worth supporting
